description: What Bookkeeping AP needs before it can start: a Xero login that reaches your clients' organisations, and the mailbox that receives supplier bills (Outlook, Hotmail or Gmail; any one is enough, and none is needed if bills only come through Hubdoc or Dext). The manager and reviewer are chosen on the agent's Basics page. It reads the Inbox and picks up bills from the day it's turned on.
name: Bookkeeping AP setup
